name: Wakatsuki Tsukasa
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c3565]Yuki[/url]'s childhood friend, Tsukasa, is a gentle girl who acts as the mediator between Yuki and Tsukasa's older twin sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c3567]Kagami[/url]. Also, Tsukasa is a member of the school's disciplinary committee and she is a fan of the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romance_of_the_Three_Kingdoms_%28disambiguation%29]Romance of the Three Kingdoms[/url].

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wonderful_Everyday]Wikipedia[/url]]
